title: The Chrono-Labyrinth's Arithmetic Key
core_premise: Two teenage gamers, Leo and Zara, are trapped inside a virtual reality escape room game called 'Chrono-Labyrinth.' To escape before their neural link becomes permanent, they must solve a series of time-based puzzles that are secretly governed by arithmetic progressions. The final puzzle reveals the game's creator hid a real-world treasure using AP patterns—the stakes are winning a life-changing scholarship and exposing a tech conspiracy.

characters.name: Leo
characters.role: Impulsive but brilliant gamer who notices patterns instinctively
characters.personality: Energetic, competitive, acts first-thinks-later, but has a photographic memory for sequences
characters.visual_description: 15-year-old boy, lean athletic build, messy electric-blue hair styled in choppy spikes, bright hazel eyes, light olive skin, wears a worn black gaming hoodie with neon green circuit patterns, baggy cargo pants, always has custom AR glasses hanging around his neck that flicker with code

characters.name: Zara
characters.role: Methodical coder and puzzle-solver who approaches problems logically
characters.personality: Calm under pressure, analytical, skeptical, trusts data over gut feelings, secretly wants to prove her math skills can beat any game
characters.visual_description: 16-year-old girl, tall and slender, long dark brown hair tied in a practical braid with one bright purple streak, sharp intelligent gray eyes, warm medium-brown skin, wears a sleek violet tech-jacket over a simple white tee, practical black leggings, always carries a holographic wrist-projector that displays geometric schematics
